holds.candidate: GEN02 / Safe Host SH2 physical campus, Gland (CloudSigma Geneva candidate)
holds.reason: Recent original CloudSigma physical operation is established at its Geneva cloud, but the exact provider-to-host and selected locator scope were not closed to admission confidence. The original facility-location page survives only as a cached web-search representation, while direct HTTP and web-open now return 410. Its Geneva block names GEN02/SH2, but its separate Zurich block contains a conflicting ZH5 description under a GEN02 label. The current operator address has an official numeric address entry, but its administrative-building location has not been independently resolved to the intended data-centre campus anchor. No new physical site or lifecycle row is selected.

observed_status_review.date_semantics: Original incident updates at 14:31 UTC describe simultaneous physical network-device reboot and loss of connectivity to storage nodes; the 14:54 UTC update says Geneva fixed. This is a physical-host operation observation, not an opening or proof of continuous uptime. It does not itself name GEN02 or Gland.
observed_status_review.excluded_successor_inference: The separate September 19 endpoint migration zrh→gva and November scheduled/API status notices do not establish a physical host move, a data-centre opening, or a new physical observation at GEN02.

locator_review.scope_caution: Official building-register entry 280079147 has 991 m² footprint, seven storeys and 2019 construction year; these values are identity/context only, not data-centre metrics. The entry may be the campus administrative building rather than the server building. Original contractor INDUNI explicitly describes one Safe Host development combining data-centre and administrative buildings at 32, 34, 36; that evidence is retained, but no administrative point is silently promoted to a surveyed server/building location.
locator_review.operator_brand_boundary: Current Vaultica page identifies GEN02 at 32; STACK original GEN02 brochure describes the same named campus. Hikube current original page identifies GLD as STACK GEN02. No separate Vaultica and STACK physical hosts are created and no exact ownership/lease relationship is normalized.

rejected_other_numeric_source.reason: Original contractor project sheet supplies a materially different address/point and source scope concerns exterior works. Not accepted as operator/government locator or silently reconciled to GEN02.
